engine_requirements: Add adapter html_listing to the edge function. Request: GET https://science.osti.gov/ber/Funding-Opportunities with a plain User-Agent, no cookies, no JS. Parse: for each element matching div.funding_tertiary_column, take the first a inside h5 for title (text) and href (resolve against https://science.osti.gov). For each div.details_announcement, read the div.announcement_detail_left label (strip trailing colon) and the sibling div.annoucement_detail_right value (note the misspelling 'annoucement' is in the live markup; match it exactly). Map labels: 'Announcement Number' -> external_id (strip any trailing parenthetical such as ' (updated April 20, 2026)'), 'Post Date' -> posted, 'Close Date' -> deadline (parse 'Wednesday, September 30, 2026' style dates to ISO). Emit one opportunity per container with external_id, title, url, deadline, status 'open' when deadline is in the future. Zero containers while HTML length is above 1500 chars is a parse failure and must raise, not return empty. Keep the html change-detection fallback so a page-layout change alerts instead of silently dropping rows.
